candidates.name: 3M 2110NA Indoor Transparent Weather Sealing Tape
candidates.evidenceFinding: Exact manufacturer specifications, a substantial owner-feedback record and the stocked Amazon Australia listing support temporary use over a confirmed small interior crack.
candidates.safetyFinding: It cannot cover required ventilation, access or escape openings and may damage weak paint; it is not a repair for a large, moving or irregular gap.

candidates.name: 3M 2141W-6 Indoor Window Insulator Kit
candidates.evidenceFinding: The exact kit has manufacturer and recurring owner evidence, but the Amazon Australia offer was only temporarily orderable without a delivery estimate at review.
candidates.safetyFinding: It changes window operation and is unsuitable where the opening is needed for ventilation, access or escape; surface adhesion and removal also remain condition-specific.

candidates.name: Raven RP-series perimeter and door seals
candidates.evidenceFinding: Australian manufacturer information exists across multiple profiles, but no exact, currently stocked Amazon Australia listing with a matching profile, dimensions and dependable owner record was established.
candidates.safetyFinding: The correct profile depends on measured gap, door movement, sill, drainage, fire or smoke-door status and surface; treating the range as interchangeable would be unsafe and misleading.

reviews.articleSpecificReason: The route teaches readers to identify the leak and preserve required ventilation before selecting a profile. One cleared temporary tape does not form a fair two-product set across doors, windows and intentional openings.
